title: feat(spec)!: delete checkPageComponentViewData; the component-props rule is the one judge of a page component's retired api data binding
body:
Fixes #23447
Clause-②: yes

Ruling `6161173492` on #23388, item 6, verbatim:

> 6. #23357's narrow judge proceeds as triaged and does not wait. Once this PR lands, that judge overlaps the general rule and is deleted (one operation, two implementations: the governed side wins), in #23357's PR if it is still open, else in a one-line follow-up.

PR #23418 (`d0c09e47c1`) put `validateComponentProps` on the runtime save door for `page` writes. This PR deletes the page-parse judge that duplicated it, rewrites the sentences that became false, and re-pins the save door on the props rule.

## What changes

1. **The narrow judge is deleted** (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`): `checkPageComponentViewData`, `VIEW_DATA_SOURCE_COMPONENT_TYPES`, their docblocks, the `.superRefine` on `PageSchema`, and the now-unused `ViewDataSchema` import. The published export leaves `@objectstack/spec/ui`; `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json` were regenerated with `check:generated --fix` (one line each). `page-component-view-data.test.ts` is deleted, since its subject is gone. Its reach and control cases move to the save-door pins below, which run the real rule. In `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` the judge's fixtures and rows are removed, and absence pins (0 declarations, 0 attachments, not in the barrel) follow the `checkListViewPageMount` precedent.
2. **Sentences rewritten:**
   - the `refused-shapes.ts` docblocks and `COMPONENT_API_BINDING_FATE`, with their tests;
   - `18.view-data-api-provider-retired.ts` `acceptanceCriteria`;
   - `18.ui-page-action-row-declarative-update-rules.ts` `reason`;
   - the `validate-component-props.ts` header ("does not run this rule" at the runtime publish door);
   - the `view.zod.ts` comment;
   - the `PageSchema` trailing comment ("five checks" is now four).
3. **The stored-page fate was measured before it was rewritten** (table below). The new fate text says what was measured: the page loads and is served with no read diagnostic, and its next save is refused by the props rule.
4. **Pins** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, new describe after the #23388 block). They run the real `saveMetaItem` / `loadMetaFromDb` / `getMetaItem` path:
   - each of `object-grid`, `object-map`, `object-gantt` and `object-tree` → `422 INVALID_METADATA`, `rulesRun` contains `validateComponentProps`, one `component-props-invalid` issue carrying the prescription at `pages[0].regions[0].components[0].properties.data.provider`, nothing stored;
   - reach: a `page:tabs` item, a component nested in `flex` › `page:card`, and a slot;
   - control: `provider: 'object'` and `provider: 'value'` save, one row each;
   - stored page: `loadMetaFromDb` → `loaded: 1, errors: 0, invalid: 0`, the page is registered, no `metadata_spec_invalid` warning, `getMetaItem` serves it as stored with `_diagnostics.valid: true`, its next save is refused by the props rule with the row unchanged, and the fixed page saves.
   - The old `#23357` block in `protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts` (a spec-parse `custom` issue, plus a read-path `_diagnostics.valid: false` pin, which is now false) is removed.

## Each door, before and after (measured)

| door | before (`29c7157af4`) | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PageSchema.safeParse` / `definePage` / `defineStack` | refused: `custom` at `regions.0.components.0.properties.data.provider` (and at each nested and slot position) | **accepted**: these doors run no lint rule. This is the ruling's expected consequence. No equivalent check was added to spec. |
| `os validate` (built CLI, `defineStack` config) | exit 1: `defineStack validation failed` with the prescription | exit 1: `component-props-invalid at pages[0].regions[0].components[0].properties.data.provider` with the prescription; the control config (`provider: 'object'`) passes, exit 0 |
| `os build` | exit 2: refused inside `defineStack` | exit 1: the same `component-props-invalid` finding; control exit 0 |
| save door `saveMetaItem` | 422 `INVALID_METADATA`, `failed spec validation`, issue `code: custom`, no `rulesRun` | 422 `INVALID_METADATA`, `failed author-time validation`, rule `component-props-invalid`, `rulesRun` contains `validateComponentProps`, nothing stored |
| boot `loadMetaFromDb` | `loaded: 1, errors: 0, invalid: 1`, `[metadata_spec_invalid]` warning | `loaded: 1, errors: 0, invalid: 0`, registered, no warning |
| read `getMetaItem` | served, `_diagnostics.valid: false` with the refusal at the component | served as stored, `_diagnostics.valid: true` |

Rule-level reach, the same before and after (the probe ran `validateComponentProps` on 10 page bodies, with identical output on both trees): one finding per binding on all four types, the bare `{ provider }`, a `page:tabs` item, `flex` › `page:card` › component, `slots.details` and `slots.header[0]`. No finding on the `object` and `value` controls or on a custom type. An `object-kanban` carrying the binding draws `component-props-invalid` at `properties.data` (`expected array`), which is its own row's verdict, as before.

## Merge with main

`origin/main` `43567a8f` (PR #23708, PR #23800 included) was merged in at `4087b452`, through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`:
- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`: Conflict at the PageSchema superRefine chain. Kept main's checkPageDefaultPlacement and checkPageRegionPlacement (PR #23708, #23610 ruling A), dropped the deleted checkPageComponentViewData. The trailing comment reads 'the six checks above', and the props-bag sentence stays.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts`: 5 hunks: main's side in each, minus every checkPageComponentViewData line, i.e. the import, the view-data fixture block (main's #23610 fixtures kept), the MIRRORED row and the barrel row. The leg-3 'declares all six exports' loop names the 4 old checks plus the 2 new ones. This PR's 0-declaration, 0-attachment and barrel-absence pins are kept.
- `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json, packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`: os-regen driver, not text-merged. Step 2 took main's side, the merge commit was the deferral, then rebuild + gen:api-surface + gen:export-origins on the merged tree, committed as 392224ea. The deferral was discharged. Delta vs origin/main: exactly one removed line in each (checkPageComponentViewData). main's 9 new ui exports are present.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-page-action-row-declarative-update-rules.ts`: No conflict: PR #23800 left this line to this PR. Aligned with #23800's wording precedent: '... the load path runs no such gate, so a stored page still loads and its next save meets the component-props gate at the metadata save door.'

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION

File: `.changeset/pre/23357-page-component-view-data-api-refused.md`, commit `7c25be0a`. `18.0.0-next.2` consumed the note, and the 18.0.0 GA entry is compiled from `.changeset/pre/` again (`release.yml`: "On `pre exit` the GA version consumes them all again"). This PR makes the following sentences false, and each is rewritten in place, measured against this PR's head:
1. Title: "the page parse refuses …" → "a page component's `data` prop that names the retired view-level `api` data source is refused at the Studio, REST and MCP save door as `os validate` refuses it".
2. BREAKING paragraph: "is now refused by `PageSchema`" and "the component-props gate … runs at the CLI doors only" → the props gate (`validateComponentProps`, rule `component-props-invalid`) refuses it at `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint` and the metadata save door. The CLI-only fact now reads as history: "before 18".
3. Judge paragraph: "raised by the page parse unchanged (… `code` is `custom` …)" → the props row parses `data` with `ViewDataSchema`, and the finding carries that schema's prescription. The row-array types are refused for their shape, not with this prescription. The `checkPageComponentViewData` … re-attach sentence is deleted.
4. FROM → TO header: "(accepted by the page parse until this change)" → "(saved by the Studio, REST and MCP door before 18)".
5. "`definePage()`, `defineStack({ pages })` … refuse the page" → `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` and `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/:name` refuse it; `definePage()` and `defineStack({ pages })` run no authoring rule and accept it.
6. Stored page: "registered under `[metadata_spec_invalid]` with the refusal in the `_diagnostics` of every read" → served as stored, with no read diagnostic for the binding; the next save is refused with 422 by the props gate. objectui#12325 is now in the console pin, so the sentence changes from "until then a stored page keeps sending it" to "so a stored page does not send the request".
7. ADR-0087 marker reason: "makes the page parse refuse …" → "the component-props gate refuses what that entry retired at the CLI doors and the save door"; the disposition token itself is unchanged.

Authority: the maintainer's 「同意」, recorded in `6210183493`, as applied by `6210987382` (which supersedes `6210952492`), with PR #23418's `6203578381` as the precedent. `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` is untouched. `Check Changeset` reds by design on this edit (`check-empty-changeset`: DELIBERATE CORRECTION class); it is not a required context and runs only on `pull_request`.

## Verification

- **Final head `7c25be0a`** (rounds after the merge). `dispatch-gates --commands`: 90 derived, 89 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, left to CI). 88 exit 0, plus `check-empty-changeset` exit 1, by design, for the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class. `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0. On `39977e95`: spec 682 files / 20873 tests, lint 140 files / 6781, metadata-protocol pin files 170/170, typechecks exit 0. On `40624b32`: `refused-shapes.test.ts` + `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` 284/284, `check:generated` and `check:doc-authoring` exit 0. `7c25be0a` adds only the changeset text.
- **Round 1** (before the merge):

- Ablation of the general rule's runtime face: `validateComponentProps`'s entry was set to `surfaces: ['cli']` with `runtimeTypes` removed (through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). `@objectstack/lint` was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 built files. Result: the 6 refusal pins went red and the control stayed green. On restore, the blob matched the HEAD hash, the rebuild passed `--absent` with a clean tree, and the whole file is green at 145/145.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: `pnpm test`, 236 files and 20580 tests passed; `pnpm typecheck` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/spec`: full `pnpm test` showed one failure (a missed `#23357` half in `refused-shapes.test.ts`), which is fixed. Re-run: `refused-shapes.test.ts` and `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` 250/250, and `pnpm typecheck` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/lint`: `pnpm test`, 139 files and 6771 tests passed; `pnpm typecheck` exit 0.
- `check:generated`: 2 artifacts were stale (`api-surface`, `export-origins`) and were regenerated; the other 12 were up to date.
- `check:adr-0087-registration`: `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (already-registered)`.
- The derived gate families (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 90 commands) were run locally; their results are in the report comment on #23447.

## Acceptance notes

- **The rest of the family is closed.** PR #23418 made the stale save-half sentences false. PR #23800 (#23789) rewrote them and landed before this PR merged `main`. The one line it left for this PR, in `18.ui-page-action-row-declarative-update-rules.ts`, now follows #23800's wording.
- **The 23357 note** had been consumed by `18.0.0-next.2` into `.changeset/pre/`, and the 18.0.0 GA entry is compiled from there again. It is corrected in place: see `## DELIBERATE CORRECTION`. The published `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` entry is untouched.
- **`@objectstack/lint: patch` was dropped** from this PR's changeset. The lint diff is the file-top comment of `validate-component-props.ts`, and no changeset gate asks for it.
- **`COMPONENT_API_BINDING_FATE`** (`refused-shapes.ts`) now says the console no longer reads the retired arm. objectui#12325 has been in the console pin since PR #23709 (`53e3638e`).
- **The `_diagnostics` field is not absent** after the change: it reads `valid: true`, and the pin asserts that.
